data.spec: User requests theoretical room-already-booked → follow-up 'Send him a message' → WhatsApp. Implementing bounded backend RoomMessaging workflow with injected booking/contact source, structured live model draft, exact recipient bound to current booking owner (model never supplies phone), persisted draft+send attempt/idempotency and no uncertain retries. Example booking explicitly simulated; no real room calendar/book/reschedule writes claimed. Current app has no room calendar adapter. Real WhatsApp test awaits authenticated Business connection and verified recipient (provided privately; never shared plan/Git). No dashboard/speech/other-owner edits. No generic new operating-state replacement.
